images.name: 布章拾光
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing.
Make ONE polished game-interface VISUAL DESIGN BOARD for "Little Elsewhere", proposal "50  布章拾光 / Stitched Keepsakes". Landscape approximately 16:11 board, thin header, upper 64% full main game viewport, bottom 30% enlarged THREE interaction state mockups OUTSIDE the actual game viewport.

IMAGE 1 is the locked original game background. Insert its EXACT composition and preserve its normal full-color painterly/pixel art as closely as possible. Keep tree, birds, mountains, broad curved river, far town, right house, sun, window frame, balcony, plants, food dish, coffee mug and green closed book. DO NOT turn the landscape into fabric, embroidery, felt, pixel LCD, monochrome, blue print, or a new art style. Style ONLY UI components on top and the off-screen detail mockups.

VISUAL DIRECTION: authentic Japanese craft-shop embroidered patch journal. Every UI component is constructed as a SMALL, refined stitched fabric patch with visible white backstitch edge, cotton weave, a felt-applique bird/sun/seed icon, simple embroidered lettering, little woven-label tabs and ribbon bookmarks. Rich INDIGO DENIM + chalk-white cotton + muted teal with tiny VERMILION thread accent. Strong textile silhouette, sharp sewn corners, scalloped patch badges, not generic beige rounded pill panels. Typography slightly hand-lettered but Chinese clearly legible. One physical material system at thumbnail scale. No glossy plastic or 3D. Do not make a huge decorative outer fabric frame around the game.

GAMEPLAY HUD: compact indigo stitched bookmark ribbon across lower-left sill with four individual embroidered symbol tabs "观察", "图鉴", "奇遇", "陪伴". A little scalloped "12/50" collection patch at its end. Lower-right a small seed bag-shaped UI badge with feeding fill-stitches "余粮 68%" and a tiny plus button. Upper-left a small white cotton visiting patch showing a stitched sparrow, "麻雀来访", five small familiarity stitch dots. Upper-right small two-part fabric weather/focus label "晴" and "25:00" with play triangle and tiny headphone stitch icon. Main UI around 10–12% of viewport at margins, center water/mountains clear. Enough interactive information and hierarchy, not only three text buttons. At most one small contextual popover.

OUTSIDE GAME VIEWPORT: bottom band is deep INDIGO woven cotton presentation background, unmistakably different from beige paper UI boards. Three enlarged coordinated UI state mockups separated by stitched arrows:
1 heading "发现来客": a white cotton observation card with large exquisitely embroidered original sparrow badge, "第 3 次来访", familiarity five stitch-pips, small "记录" stitched button.
2 heading "布章图鉴": a fabric album showing 6 collectible felt badges, categories "鸟 / 虫 / 奇遇", 4 discovered embroidered bird/insect badges + 2 darker outlined silhouettes, selected badge has tiny vermilion ribbon pin, collection "12/50".
3 heading "来访纪念": a stitched milestone ribbon with five slots 3 filled, a feather-shaped textile memento, short "再来 2 次", "收下纪念" button and tiny star-bookmark. High-quality icons and tactile construction, carefully designed button states and visual hierarchy.
Board header exact short title "50  布章拾光" and subtitle "Little Elsewhere / Stitched Keepsakes", small textile swatch marks.

Strong stylization comes from SHAPES, MATERIAL, TYPOGRAPHY, ICONS and interaction organization, not merely color tint. These are conceptual mockups: readable compact Chinese labels only, no invented dense paragraphs. Avoid repeating all-beige parchment panels, flat generic app dashboards, excessive corner ornaments, full-window decorative frames, scene repainting, vignette or color-grading over background. Keep the visual richness in the interface.
